messages:
mike.p: Heads-up — large enterprise pilot (AcmeHealth) just signed conditional SOW. They require customer-managed KMS + an on-prem connector for EHR data ingestion. Sales wants a pilot launch in 6 weeks. This touches OKR-Q3-PROD-2 (Private deployments) and may require scope change. Can we triage?

  tara.e: Oof, 6 weeks is tight. KMS integration + on-prem connector is ~3 sprint work for eng-platform team. We can do a very constrained pilot surface if we narrow requirements. What exactly does Acme need for pilot vs full product?

  sophia.s: Sales note — pilot requires: (1) bring-your-own-kms support for at-rest encryption, (2) outbound-only on-prem connector (pull model), (3) SLA 99.9 for latency under 400ms for critical routes. Pilot is revenue-backed (~$150k) and strategic in healthcare.

  dan.cs: From CS: Acme will only move forward if we can guarantee no PHI leaves their VPC and we provide simple audit logs. They accepted a "pilot" label but expect production-like controls.

  lisa.f: Finance — need clear cost delta. If this pulls 3 sprints from core Private roadmap, impact to OKR delivery rates and forecasted Dedicated upsells must be quantified. Please provide estimated engineering FTE and infra cost.

  tara.e: Quick engineering estimate: 3 engineers x 3 sprints (~6 wks) to build minimal BYO-KMS integration + connector hack (no full routing UI). Infra incremental cost for pilot likely $12k-$20k for isolation and test infra. This assumes we can reuse existing deployment infra and feature-flag the changes.

  mike.p: Proposal: split into "pilot-only" MVP scope vs full Private GA. Pilot-MVP: BYO-KMS for storage keys, connector that can be deployed as customer-managed container with a thin proxy, and audit hooks (logs only). Defer UI for tenant KMS config and advanced key rotation to later. If we agree, we ask product leadership to reallocate one squad slice from OKR-Q3-PROD-2 to this pilot.

  kevin.o: ops note — we can support a customer-managed connector as a container image + manifest. Security review will still take 1 week. KMS integration requires secret provisioning flow; recommend leveraging existing KMS interface adapter.

  mike.p: Draft OKR change (short):
  ```
  OKR-Q3-PROD-2 (Private deployments) — Adjusted: ship Private pilot integration for strategic enterprise (AcmeHealth) as a limited pilot (pilot-only BYO-KMS + connector) by 2026-04-30. Defer full tenant UI and rotation to Q4. Success metric: pilot completes health checks + 1 production data pipe with audited logs.
  ```

  sophia.s: +1 from sales if timeline holds. This pilot unlocks potential $750k ARR within 12 months, per Acme forecast. Need commitment on security review timeline.

  lisa.f: If we accept, finance asks for a commit to re-evaluate net-new revenue vs deferred roadmap impact at the end of pilot. Please add a simple FTE + cost table in the follow-up doc.

  tara.e: Engineering accept in principle for pilot-MVP if scope is enforced. Request: freeze any additional feature asks during pilot. We'll staff 2 SWE + 1 infra for 6 weeks. Should we convert an existing sprint commitment (OKR tasks) into this work or add burn? Prefer converting devex infra tasks rather than core runtime features.

  dan.cs: CS will own pilot onboarding + runbook. Can we get a temporary playbook entry for required customer-side steps? I'll draft this and tag security.

  pm-bot: POLL: Approve pilot-only scope & OKR patch (yes/no) — vote by EOD.

  mike.p: Action items agreed: (1) Mike to publish PRD update with pilot-MVP scope and the cost table by EOD. (2) Tara to confirm staffing and security window by tomorrow. (3) Lisa to model revenue vs deferred-deliverable risk. (4) Dan to draft onboarding runbook. If poll passes, product leadership will sign off on temporary OKR adjustment.

  tara.e: Vote: :+1: — will confirm exact sprint moves tomorrow.

  sophia.s: Vote: :+1:

  lisa.f: Vote: :+1: conditional on cost table

  dan.cs: Vote: :+1:

  mike.p: Thanks all — I'll post the PRD update in #product-docs and link here when ready. Closing thread for now, will reopen if any blocker. :white_check_mark:
